evidence_review.authority: ODA v5.4.1 §§20.4.96.1 and 20.4.99 define cell alignment as raw RS, followed after the separate R2007+ unknown BL by CadValue flags/type. libdxfrw follows that sequence. The pinned ACadSharp source is not identical for alignment: readTableCellData uses ReadBitShort (variable BS) for the RS field, so its decoded cell values do not independently prove the physical span.
evidence_review.peer_limit: ACadSharp at commit 3a52a52047e84670759c1f9ad3916ec3ce85ff56 successfully decodes the table values but reads the alignment override differently from ODA. LibreDWG 0.14 retains these ACAD_TABLE bodies as unknown bits. Neither peer supplies independent source spans for the candidate type-48 positions.
evidence_review.interpretation: The first unsupported candidate is localized to row 8/column 0 in handle 0x2856e and row 9/column 0 in handle 0x2a974. Both cells carry alignment override flag 0x01 in the local cursor trace. A generated raw-RS boundary control now covers the normative alignment field and following CadValue/sentinel, but does not resolve the physical candidate. The exact preceding cursor difference remains open; do not add a type-48 decoder or claim malformed source data until an independent source-span walk resolves it.
evidence_review.disposition: No production parser change. Keep both TABLE bodies semantically incomplete and output-gated until exact source spans or an independent producer decode resolve the preceding fields. No support claim is promoted.
